name: CS2 Modded - PUG and Retake
author: me@matregnago.com
description: Counter-Strike 2 with CounterStrikeSharp, MatchZy, Retakes, ChatControl, and Inventory Simulator. Starts in PUG.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export HOME=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "$HOME/steamcmd" "$HOME/steamapps" "$HOME/.steam/sdk32" "$HOME/.steam/sdk64"
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl lib32gcc-s1
archive="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$archive"' EXIT
curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz -o "$archive"
tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$HOME/steamcmd"
cd "$HOME/steamcmd"
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "$HOME" +login anonymous +app_update 730 +quit
test -x "$HOME/game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2"
install -m 644 linux32/steamclient.so "$HOME/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
install -m 644 linux64/steamclient.so "$HOME/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Start map
variables.description: Built-in map loaded on startup in PUG mode.

variables.name: Admin SteamID64s
variables.description: Comma- or space-separated SteamID64s for MatchZy and CounterStrikeSharp.

variables.name: Steam GSLT
variables.description: Steam game server login token, if used.

variables.name: Steam Web API key
variables.description: Optional auth key for Workshop maps.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Optional password for players joining the server.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: Optional RCON password. An empty value disables RCON.

variables.name: Update CS2 on startup
variables.description: Set to 0 to skip SteamCMD updates after installation. Mods are still checked.
